sSQLDNCQry.defaultValue: SELECT        dnc.EFFECTIVEDATE AS EffDATE, dnc.CLIENT_NBR, CAST(SUBSTR(dnc.CLIENT_NBR, - 3) as integer) AS Client, (SUBSTR(dnc.BR_ACCOUNT_CD,1, 3) || '-' || SUBSTR(dnc.BR_ACCOUNT_CD, 4, 5) || '-' || SUBSTR(dnc.BR_ACCOUNT_CD, 9, 1) || '-' || SUBSTR(dnc.BR_ACCOUNT_CD, -1)) AS br_acct, dnc.BR_ACCOUNT_CD, SUBSTR(dnc.BR_ACCOUNT_SHORT_NM,1, 4) AS trader, dnc.BR_ACCOUNT_SHORT_NM, glm.INVENTORY_CATEGORY FROM BPSA.GL_WF_DAILY_NET_CHANGEHIST dnc, ISP.GLINVENTORYMAPPING glm

sSQL.defaultValue: SELECT SUBSTR(CLIENT_NBR, - 3) AS CLIENT_NBR, EFFECTIVEDATE, PRODUCTION_DT, BR_BRANCH_CD, BR_ACCOUNT_CD, BR_ACCOUNT_NM, SUBSTR(LTRIM(RTRIM(BR_ACCOUNT_NM)), - 4) AS trader_cd,  ISO_CURRENCY_CD, GL_COMPANY_CD, GL_ACCOUNT_CD, GL_AU_CD, GL_PRODUCT_CD, GL_INVENTORY_CD, BAL_IN, DAILY_BAL_AMT, CLOSING_BAL_AMT, CASE SUBSTR(br_branch_cd,-1) WHEN '2' THEN closing_bal_amt ELSE 0 END AS unitcost_bal_amt, CASE SUBSTR(br_branch_cd,-1) WHEN '3' THEN closing_bal_amt ELSE 0 END AS mtm_bal_amt, UPDT_LAST_TMSTP, YEAR_END_IND  FROM BPSA.GL_WF_TRIAL_BALANCEHIST  WHERE (BR_BRANCH_CD IN ('112', '113', '132', '133', '512', '513')) AND (EFFECTIVEDATE = 20221219)  AND (TO_CHAR(PRODUCTION_DT, 'YYYYMMDD')= 20221219)

sSQLGLInvMap.defaultValue: SELECT DISTINCT SYSDATE AS EffDATE ,BR_CL_NBR AS CLIENT_NBR ,CAST(SUBSTR(BR_CL_NBR, - 3) as integer) AS Client ,BR_INVENTORY_ACCT AS br_acct ,REPLACE(BR_INVENTORY_ACCT,'-') AS BR_ACCOUNT_CD ,SUBSTR(FO_TRADER_ACCT_DESC,1, 4) AS trader ,FO_TRADER_ACCT_DESC AS BR_ACCOUNT_SHORT_NM ,glm.INVENTORY_CATEGORY FROM ISP.GLINVENTORYMAPPING glm

sSQLQry.defaultValue: SELECT SUBSTR(CLIENT_NBR, - 3) AS CLIENT_NBR, EFFECTIVEDATE, PRODUCTION_DT, BR_BRANCH_CD, BR_ACCOUNT_CD, BR_ACCOUNT_NM, SUBSTR(LTRIM(RTRIM(BR_ACCOUNT_NM)), - 4) AS trader_cd, ISO_CURRENCY_CD, GL_COMPANY_CD, GL_ACCOUNT_CD, GL_AU_CD, GL_PRODUCT_CD, GL_INVENTORY_CD, BAL_IN, DAILY_BAL_AMT, CLOSING_BAL_AMT, CASE SUBSTR(br_branch_cd,-1) WHEN '2' THEN closing_bal_amt ELSE 0 END AS unitcost_bal_amt,  CASE SUBSTR(br_branch_cd,-1) WHEN '3' THEN closing_bal_amt ELSE 0 END AS mtm_bal_amt, UPDT_LAST_TMSTP, YEAR_END_IND FROM BPSA.GL_WF_TRIAL_BALANCEHIST WHERE  (BR_BRANCH_CD IN ('112', '113', '132', '133', '512', '513'))

sSQLDNC.defaultValue: SELECT        dnc.EFFECTIVEDATE AS EffDATE, dnc.CLIENT_NBR, CAST(SUBSTR(dnc.CLIENT_NBR, - 3) as integer) AS Client, (SUBSTR(dnc.BR_ACCOUNT_CD,1, 3) || '-' || SUBSTR(dnc.BR_ACCOUNT_CD, 4, 5) || '-' || SUBSTR(dnc.BR_ACCOUNT_CD, 9, 1) || '-' || SUBSTR(dnc.BR_ACCOUNT_CD, -1)) AS br_acct, dnc.BR_ACCOUNT_CD, SUBSTR(dnc.BR_ACCOUNT_SHORT_NM,1, 4) AS trader, dnc.BR_ACCOUNT_SHORT_NM, glm.INVENTORY_CATEGORY FROM BPSA.GL_WF_DAILY_NET_CHANGEHIST dnc, ISP.GLINVENTORYMAPPING glm WHERE EFFECTIVEDATE = 20200204 AND dnc.CLIENT_NBR = glm.BR_CL_NBR AND dnc.BR_ACCOUNT_SHORT_NM = glm.FO_TRADER_ACCT_DESC GROUP BY dnc.EFFECTIVEDATE, dnc.CLIENT_NBR, SUBSTR(dnc.CLIENT_NBR, -3), SUBSTR(dnc.BR_ACCOUNT_CD,1, 3) || '-' || SUBSTR(dnc.BR_ACCOUNT_CD, 4, 5) || '-' || SUBSTR(dnc.BR_ACCOUNT_CD, 9, 1) || '-' || SUBSTR(dnc.BR_ACCOUNT_CD, -1), dnc.BR_ACCOUNT_CD, SUBSTR(dnc.BR_ACCOUNT_CD, 3), SUBSTR(dnc.BR_ACCOUNT_SHORT_NM, 4), dnc.BR_ACCOUNT_SHORT_NM, glm.INVENTORY_CATEGORY HAVING (SUBSTR(dnc.BR_ACCOUNT_SHORT_NM, 4) <> 'TRAN') AND (SUBSTR(dnc.BR_ACCOUNT_SHORT_NM, 1, 3) <> 'JPM') AND (SUBSTR(dnc.BR_ACCOUNT_SHORT_NM, 1, 4) IS NOT NULL) AND (SUBSTR(dnc.BR_ACCOUNT_SHORT_NM, 1, 4) NOT IN ('COLU', 'T410', 'M510', '2J10')) AND        (glm.INVENTORY_CATEGORY LIKE '%EQUITY%') AND (SUBSTR(dnc.BR_ACCOUNT_SHORT_NM, 5, 1) = '-') AND (SUBSTR(dnc.BR_ACCOUNT_SHORT_NM, 1, 4) IS NOT NULL)
